summary: This section explains the main duties of a company secretary under the law. A company secretary must report to the board on legal compliance, make sure the company follows secretarial standards, and perform any other assigned duties. These rules do not reduce the responsibilities of the board of directors, chairperson, or managing directors.
points: Report to the board of directors about compliance with this Act, its rules, and other applicable laws.
Ensure that the company follows all applicable secretarial standards.
Perform any other duties that may be prescribed by law.
Do not replace or reduce the duties and functions of the board of directors, chairperson, managing director, or whole-time director.
example: Meera Textiles Private Limited hired Aarav as its company secretary. Aarav regularly checked the company activities to make sure they followed all the rules under the Companies Act and other applicable laws, and he reported his findings directly to the board of directors. He also made sure the company followed the secretarial standards issued by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. Meanwhile, the managing director of Meera Textiles Private Limited continued to handle daily business operations and decision-making without Aarav taking over those leadership duties.

terms.meaning: An officer responsible for ensuring that a company complies with legal and regulatory requirements.
Official standards issued by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and approved by the Central Government.
The group of people chosen to manage and direct the affairs of a company.

watch: People often think a company secretary takes over the duties of the board of directors, but the law states this is not true.
